description: One 5 GiB file (the spec's size target): 640 chunks of 8 MiB, 8 in parallel, then download and verify the SHA-256.

where.docker: Docker Desktop, engine 29.9.2; its Linux VM has 4 CPUs and 7.8 GB
where.server: one app container (one uvicorn process) from commit 9ecad34, Postgres 16, Versity S3 gateway v1.10.0 (posix backend on a Docker volume), all in that VM
where.client: scripts/load_test.py on the Windows host (Python 3.12.13, httpx 0.28.1) through Docker's port forwarding to localhost:8001
where.config: defaults: 16 storage workers, DB pool 10 + 10, 8 chunks in flight per upload, global in-flight 128, queue 512, download_prefetch 1 (the default when these runs were made)
